verses.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses, giving the next instructions: 📣
‘Tell Aaron and his sons to keep back from the sacred offerings Israel sets apart for me, so they don’t drag my holy name down. I am Yahweh. 🕊️
‘If any of Aaron’s descendants comes near the sacred offerings while ritually unclean, that person must be cut off from my presence. I am Yahweh. ⚠️

‘Any descendant of Aaron with a skin disease or bodily discharge must stay off the sacred food until clean. Same goes for anyone who touches something made unclean by a dead body or a man’s semen emission, 🩺
or touches a crawling creature that makes them unclean, or another person’s uncleanness—whatever the source. 🐾
Anyone who touches any of that stays unclean till evening and must not eat sacred food until they’ve bathed in water. 🚿
Once the sun goes down, they’re clean and can eat the sacred food—it’s their daily bread. 🌇
They must not eat an animal that died on its own or got torn up by another animal, making themselves unclean. I am Yahweh. 🚫
‘They must stick to my instructions, or they’ll carry guilt and die for treating sacred offerings like ordinary stuff. I am Yahweh, who makes them holy. 📜
‘No outsider gets to eat the sacred food—not a guest staying with a priest, not a hired worker. 🚫
But a priest’s purchased slave may eat it, and so may those born in his household. 🍞
If a priest’s daughter marries someone outside the priestly family, she can’t eat the sacred raised offering. 💍
But if she’s widowed or divorced, has no children, and moves back to her father’s house like before, she may eat her father’s food. No outsider gets any. 🏠
‘If someone eats sacred food without realizing, they must repay its value plus one-fifth and give it to the priest. ➕
The priests must not treat Israel’s offerings to Yahweh like everyday stuff, 🙏
or they’ll make the people carry guilt for eating sacred food. I am Yahweh, who makes them holy.’ ⚖️
Yahweh spoke to Moses again: 📣
‘Tell Aaron, his sons, and all Israel: any Israelite or foreigner living there may bring Yahweh an offering, whether keeping a vow or giving a burnt offering freely. 🎁
For that offering to be accepted, bring a flawless male from the cattle, sheep, or goats. 🐂
Don’t bring an animal with a defect; that offering won’t be accepted. 🚫
‘When someone brings a peace offering from the herd or flock—whether for a vow or given freely—it has to be flawless to be accepted. No defect. ✅
Don’t bring Yahweh an animal that’s blind, injured, maimed, or has a wart, festering, or a running sore. Don’t burn that kind on the altar. ⚠️
A bull or lamb with a deformity or missing part may be given freely, but it won’t count for fulfilling a vow. 📜
Don’t offer Yahweh an animal whose testicles are bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. Don’t do this anywhere in your land. 🚫
Don’t take any of these defective animals from a foreigner as an offering to your God; they’re damaged and won’t be accepted for you.’ ⚖️
Yahweh spoke to Moses once more: 📣
‘When a calf, lamb, or goat is born, it must stay with its mother for seven days. From day eight on, it can be accepted as a fire offering to Yahweh. 🐄
Don’t slaughter a cow or ewe and her young on the same day. 🐑
‘When you bring Yahweh a thank offering, offer it the right way so it’s accepted. 🙏
Eat it that same day; don’t leave any for morning. I am Yahweh. 🍽️
‘Keep my commands and live them out. I am Yahweh. ✅
Don’t drag my holy name down; I will be treated as holy among Israel. I am Yahweh, who makes you holy, 🕊️
who brought you out of Egypt to be your God. I am Yahweh.’ ✨
